characters.Wren Castellano: 21, Finder lineage. Leads the valley's documentation and warning project. Earnest, honest to a fault, increasingly confident in her gift but cautious of its cost. Wound: raised on being protected from truths 'for her own good'.
characters.Theo Marsh: 26, records investigator/archivist from Millbrook County, not Kindred, no gift. Meticulous, dry, patient. Wound: has built his identity around one unanswered question (his grandmother's missing decade).
characters.Mara Voss: Structural engineer, Finder, married to Caleb Reyes. Book 1 protagonist. Theme: someone can stay without every reason handed to them.
characters.Caleb Reyes: Runs Reyes Orchard. Book 1 protagonist. Two years of memory were stolen and restored (Book 2). Married to Mara.
characters.Priya Nair: Deputy, Caller lineage (compels truth/calm within 5 feet, pays with composure after). Dev's sister. Procedural, carries everyone.
characters.Dev Nair: Priya's brother, Finder. Served a sentence for redirecting tolls; now does substation evidence work.
characters.Odette Reyes: Runs the general store. Lost the exact wording of her late husband's proposal, 43 years ago, keeps the memory's joy itself.
characters.Denise: Renewed the valley's bargain in secret for 50 years; freed in Book 3's ring ritual; now ages naturally.
characters.Yusuf: Council chair. Hesitated in Book 2, acted fast in Book 3.
characters.Walt Pruitt: Ordinary townsperson; represents the town processing bigger truths alongside the reader.
characters.Corwin Drake: Book 4 antagonist. Information broker, not a ritualist. Spent 19 years since a failed first attempt (Millbrook) assembling a partial, damning record of the valley's bargain renewals. Wants control of the bargain's true administrative terms, not its destruction.
characters.Ambrose Whitlock: Deceased. Once held the 'Warden of the first debt' role; tried to end the bargain, failed, hid its complete terms rather than destroy them. Not to be confused with Ambrose Kell (Book 1 antagonist) — always use full names.

plot_facts: The bargain: Amity Falls trades memory for protection (crops, floods, sickness). Overuse of a gift 'runs a debt' paid in memory.

Six lineages: Wardens (shifters), Menders (healers), Callers (compel truth/calm), Weathers (weather influence), Finders (locate lost things/people, cost: a memory of the search), Wicks (carry flame/light, nearly died out).
'Redirecting the toll' is the valley's oldest taboo: a Finder can pay their debt with someone else's memory instead of their own.
The valley sits a few hundred yards off on satellite/GPS maps.
Book 1: Caleb's stolen two years traced to Ambrose Kell's cover-up of failing valley protection; Kell exposed, Dev revealed as the Finder he coerced.

Book 2: Denise revealed as the one renewing the bargain in secret for 50 years, personally responsible for taking Caleb's two years. A 'split the weight' ritual freed her and restored Caleb's memory. Adelaide's letter named Ambrose Whitlock as the one who taught her the bargain.

Book 3: The bargain-ending practice is hereditary as well as taught, skipping generations unpredictably. Dev is a Whitlock descendant. A 'ring' of ten volunteers distributed Dev's taking. Antagonist Corwin Drake, tied to a prior unsolved Millbrook case, confirmed still at large. Whitlock's own hidden letter found: he too tried to end the bargain, failed, and left a warning his family buried instead of sharing.

Book 4 (current): One year later. Drake resurfaces as an information broker, not a ritualist, threatening to publish his own partial, damning record of the valley's history unless given the bargain's true original terms. The 'Warden of the first debt' is revealed as a role, not a bloodline, that Whitlock once held. Wren, with Theo, must publish the complete true history first, honestly, before Drake weaponizes his partial version. Climax is a publication race and public reckoning, not a ritual at a fixed site. Drake is taken into custody by ordinary law once his leverage collapses. Series closes here — no Book 5 hook planted.

books.title: Where the Frost Doesn't Reach
books.summary: Amity Falls Book 1. Mara returns for her grandmother's funeral, finds Caleb alive but missing two years of shared memory. Antagonist Ambrose Kell exposed.

books.title: What the Valley Still Owes
books.summary: Amity Falls Book 2. Denise revealed as the one renewing the bargain in secret for 50 years. A ritual frees her and restores Caleb's memory. Whitlock named as the next thread.

books.title: What the Blood Remembers
books.summary: Amity Falls Book 3. The bargain-ending practice is hereditary. Dev is a Whitlock descendant. Corwin Drake introduced as the antagonist, defeated at a ring ritual but confirmed still at large.
